title: Adopt the R3 register export and wire the frozen-custody supplement
intent: R3 is verified in custody: bytes and sha256 match, and a 44-tab cell diff against R2 shows exactly four changes, both frozen_objects Binding Class repairs with prior values preserved verbatim. Adoption means moving current_import_source onto R3 through the manifest resolver, regenerating the 44 JSON and 44 CSV outputs, adding the eleven-row frozen-custody supplement as its own dated file rather than appending to drive/inventory.jsonl, teaching frozen_check to read it through an explicit flag, reconciling the fifteen lane D review routes, and finally filing the held H3 review record unchanged.
done_when: tools/register_migration_preflight.py --source the R3 export reports refusing=0, the full suite is green, and reviews/records/REV-H3-SOLVER-20260921.json exists with the bytes currently held under reviews/independent/.
does_not_establish: Declaring this task establishes nothing about the register, the export, or the mathematics. Adoption is a transcription of what the source register already says; it verifies no cell's meaning, moves no gate, discharges none of the five OPEN validity premises of Theorem D1 v2.2(2), and leaves D3-LEMMA-RN-UNIF not closed. READY in the review queue is the register's own word and means a review is awaited, not passed.
